title: QUESTIONNAIRES — Questionnaire Completion
description: The dates the donor started and finished the questionnaire, and the same dates for the second questionnaire (_p2) where the donor completed two.

startDate.title: Date started
startDate.$comment: Date of the (first or only) questionnaire. No date format is stated (the Categories cell is empty), so no pattern is asserted and the column is typed as text (D014).

endDate.title: Date finished
endDate.$comment: Date of the (first or only) questionnaire. No date format is stated (the Categories cell is empty), so no pattern is asserted and the column is typed as text (D014).

startDate_p2.title: Date started
startDate_p2.x-universe: Participants who completed a second questionnaire.
startDate_p2.$comment: Date of the second questionnaire (the '_p2' columns; source note on the questionnaires sheet: 'some participants were asked to complete a second questionnaire (see BasicInfo-CommsCode variable)'). No date format is stated, so no pattern is asserted and the column is typed as text (D015). The rule that ties these columns to commsCode = CP1 is not enforced: commsCode is in another table and is not requested (R003, D011).

endDate_p2.title: Date finished
endDate_p2.x-universe: Participants who completed a second questionnaire.
endDate_p2.$comment: Date of the second questionnaire (the '_p2' columns; source note on the questionnaires sheet: 'some participants were asked to complete a second questionnaire (see BasicInfo-CommsCode variable)'). No date format is stated, so no pattern is asserted and the column is typed as text (D015). The rule that ties these columns to commsCode = CP1 is not enforced: commsCode is in another table and is not requested (R003, D011).
